name: Corrected 4-Mechanism Controlled Game Ablation
description: Controlled comparison across B0 (Persistence), B1 (Static Diurnal), B2 (CNN Risk-Neutral), and B3 (Forecast-Aware Conformal EGT) under identical load profiles and shortfall penalties.
notes: Demonstrates that risk-penalty reduces aggressive over-commitment, balancing traded kWh against shortfall exposure.
